fullDescription: Luminous dark-mode glassmorphism task command center (Nebula — Mission Control): a fixed teal+magenta aurora field behind frosted-glass cards, a sticky backdrop-blurred nav, an aqua->magenta gradient hero, a 4-up glass stat strip, and a glass table panel with a faceted filter toolbar, icon+label status/priority columns, gradient avatars and a pagination footer.
prompt:
## Resumo
A dark, frosted-glass task command center ("Nebula — Mission Control") on a near-black ink canvas lit by an aurora field (teal + magenta blurred blobs) behind a faint grid. Flow: a sticky backdrop-blurred glass nav, a centered hero with gradient headline + dual CTAs, a 4-up glass stat strip, then one large rounded glass table panel holding a faceted filter toolbar, a status/priority/owner data table (with an avatar column), and a pagination footer; below it a slim footer. The aesthetic is luminous dark-mode glassmorphism: translucent panels over an aurora glow, an aqua->magenta gradient accent, Space Grotesk display + Inter body.

## Estilo Visual
Design system: dark mode, body background ink #0b0f14, body text #e7ecf2, -webkit-font-smoothing antialiased. Accent ramp: aqua #2dd4bf, a lighter aqua #7fe6dd, and magenta #e879f9 (plus a soft magenta #f0a6ff for avatars); the brand gradient is linear-gradient(135deg, #2dd4bf, #e879f9) and the headline/text gradient is linear-gradient(100deg, #2dd4bf 0%, #7fe6dd 40%, #e879f9 100%) clipped to text. Neutral text uses Tailwind slate: slate-100 #f1f5f9 (row titles), slate-200 #e2e8f0, slate-300 #cbd5e1 (nav/labels), slate-400 #94a3b8 (muted/ids), slate-500 #64748b (backlog icon). AURORA: a position:fixed full-inset layer with two blurred radial blobs - ::before 660x660px radial #2dd4bf at top:-220px left:-140px (opacity .55, blur 110px), ::after 620x620px radial #e879f9 at top:180px right:-180px (opacity .5, blur 110px). GRID: a fixed full-inset layer of 1px teal (rgba(45,212,191,.025)) + magenta (rgba(232,121,249,.02)) gridlines at 56px, masked with radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 60% at 50% 0%, #000 40%, transparent). GLASS card: background linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(20,28,38,.72), rgba(13,19,27,.6)), backdrop-filter blur(22px) saturate(140%), border 1px rgba(255,255,255,.07). GLASS-NAV: background rgba(11,15,20,.62), backdrop-filter blur(20px) saturate(160%), bottom border 1px rgba(255,255,255,.06). CHIP (inputs/buttons/pills): border 1px rgba(255,255,255,.09), background rgba(255,255,255,.03). Tag fills: feature = border rgba(45,212,191,.28)/bg rgba(45,212,191,.08); bug = border rgba(232,121,249,.28)/bg rgba(232,121,249,.08); docs = border rgba(255,255,255,.12)/bg rgba(255,255,255,.04). GLOW-AQUA shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(45,212,191,.25), 0 8px 40px -12px rgba(45,212,191,.45). Status dots use box-shadow 0 0 10px currentColor. ::selection background rgba(45,212,191,.3). Typeface: display = Space Grotesk (400/500/600/700) on the wordmark, headline, stat numerals and big numbers; body = Inter (400/500/600/700). Rounding: panel rounded-3xl, stat cards rounded-2xl, controls/buttons rounded-lg, tags rounded, avatars/pills rounded-full. Icons: Phosphor (iconify ph:*) at 14-18px.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky glass nav
Sticky top nav (sticky top-0 z-50, h-16) styled glass-nav (rgba(11,15,20,.62) + backdrop-blur(20px) saturate(160%), 1px white/6% bottom border), inside a max-w-7xl px-6/8 row. Left: a 32px rounded-lg logo tile with the brand gradient (135deg #2dd4bf->#e879f9) + glow-aqua shadow holding a dark ph:diamonds-four-fill icon, the wordmark 'Nebula' in Space Grotesk font-700 text-lg tight, and a tiny uppercase 'MC' pill (aqua/70 text, aqua/20 border). Center (md+): nav links Board / Tasks / Insights / Docs in 14px slate-300 with an aqua hover. Right: a chip 'Search' button (sm+) with a ph:magnifying-glass icon and a ⌘K kbd chip, and a primary 'Sign in' button in dark text on an aqua gradient (135deg #2dd4bf->#7fe6dd).

### Hero
Centered hero (pt-20 pb-14) inside the 1280px container. A chip pill 'Live workspace · 248 tasks in flight' with a glowing aqua dot (bg-aqua + box-shadow 0 0 10px currentColor). A two-line Space Grotesk font-700 headline at text-5xl->6xl, leading-1.05: 'Every task,' on line 1 and a gradient-text span 'in one luminous grid.' on line 2 (clipped 100deg aqua->magenta gradient). A 18px slate-400 max-w-xl subhead: 'A frosted command surface for shipping work. Filter, sort, and triage your whole pipeline without losing the room.' Two CTAs: primary 'Open the board' (dark text on aqua gradient + glow-aqua shadow) and a chip outlined 'View changelog'.

### Stat strip
A 4-up grid (2 cols mobile, 4 cols md+) of glass rounded-2xl cards (p-5). Each card: a top row with an 12px slate-400 label and a small Phosphor icon, a big Space Grotesk text-3xl font-700 number, and a 12px delta line. Cards: 'In Progress' 64 (ph:circle-half-fill aqua, '+12 this week' aqua), 'In Review' 28 (ph:eye-fill magenta, '9 awaiting you' magenta), 'Done' 142 (ph:check-circle-fill aqua, 'last 30 days' slate-400), 'Velocity' 8.4/d (ph:lightning-fill magenta, 'on pace' aqua).

### Table panel + filter toolbar
One large glass rounded-3xl panel (overflow-hidden) with a layered colored shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.05), 0 40px 90px -30px rgba(232,121,249,.18), 0 30px 60px -30px rgba(45,212,191,.18). Top toolbar (p-5, 1px white/6% bottom border, flex wrap): left cluster = a 'Filter tasks…' chip search input with a ph:magnifying-glass icon (focus border aqua/40), and two chip facet buttons 'Status' and 'Priority' each with a ph:plus-circle-dashed icon (aqua/magenta hover borders); right cluster = chip buttons 'Sort' (ph:funnel) and 'View' (ph:sliders-horizontal).

### Data table (sm+)
Inside an overflow-x-auto wrapper, a full-width table (text-sm, min-w-640px) shown at sm+. Header row: 11px uppercase tracking-wider slate-400 with a 1px white/6% bottom border; columns = a 16px rounded select-all checkbox box (1px white/15% border), Task (lg+ only), Title, Status, Priority, and a right-aligned Owner. Body rows (divide-y white/4.5%, py-3.5) hover to a faint aqua tint rgba(45,212,191,.045): a checkbox box; a mono slate-400 task id (e.g. NEB-7041, lg+); a Title cell = slate-100 task text + a small tag badge (Feature=aqua tag-feature / Bug=magenta tag-bug / Docs=white tag-docs); a Status cell = Phosphor icon + label (In Progress=ph:circle-half-fill aqua / In Review=ph:eye-fill magenta / Done=ph:check-circle-fill aqua / Backlog=ph:circle-dashed slate-500 / Canceled=ph:x-circle-fill slate-500); a Priority cell = ph:arrow-up magenta 'High' / ph:minus slate-400 'Medium' / ph:arrow-down slate-400 'Low'; a right-aligned Owner = a 24px rounded-full gradient initials avatar in dark text (JZ/RK aqua gradient 135deg #2dd4bf->#7fe6dd, AM/LT magenta gradient 135deg #e879f9->#f0a6ff). Eight sample rows.

### Mobile stacked cards (below sm)
Below the sm breakpoint, replace the table with a divide-y list of card rows (p-4, flex gap-3): a leading checkbox box, then a column with the task title (slate-100) and a trailing gradient avatar on the top row, a meta row with the mono task id + type tag, and a bottom row of status (icon+label) and priority (icon+label). Same data and color semantics as the desktop table.

### Pagination footer
Panel footer (p-5, 1px white/6% top border, flex, 14px slate-400): left = '0 of 248 row(s) selected.'; right cluster = 'Rows per page 10' (sm+), 'Page 1 of 25', and a 4-button chip pager (ph:caret-double-left + ph:caret-left disabled/slate-400-60%; ph:caret-right + ph:caret-double-right active slate-200 with aqua/30 hover border).

### Page footer
A slim footer with a 1px white/6% top border, max-w-7xl py-8 row (14px slate-400): left = a 20px rounded gradient logo tile (135deg #2dd4bf->#e879f9) with a ph:diamonds-four-fill icon + 'Nebula Mission Control'; right = 'Built for teams who ship. © 2026'.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Componente
Fixed aurora field: two heavily-blurred radial color blobs (teal + magenta) behind everything

### Componente
Masked faint grid overlay (teal/magenta gridlines fading out via a radial mask)

### Componente
Frosted-glass cards and a sticky backdrop-blurred glass nav (translucent dark fill + blur + hairline border)

### Componente
Aqua->magenta gradient accent used on the logo, the clipped gradient headline, primary buttons and avatars

### Componente
Glass stat strip (4 KPI cards with Phosphor icons and Space Grotesk numerals)

### Componente
Faceted filter toolbar (search input + Status/Priority chip facets + Sort/View)

### Componente
Status/priority data table where every state carries BOTH a Phosphor icon and a label, plus colored type tags

### Componente
Gradient initials avatars (aqua vs magenta) in an Owner column

### Componente
Glowing status dot (box-shadow 0 0 10px currentColor)

### Componente
Responsive reflow: the table collapses to stacked cards below the sm breakpoint

### Componente
Pagination footer with a rows-per-page value and a disabled-state caret pager

## Notas Especiais
This is a luminous DARK glassmorphism surface, not a flat dark theme: the mood comes from the fixed aurora field (a teal blob top-left + a magenta blob bottom-right, blurred 110px) glowing through translucent glass cards over a faint masked grid. Keep ALL content on a z-10 layer above the z-0 aurora+grid. The ONLY saturated colors are aqua #2dd4bf and magenta #e879f9, used as a 135deg gradient on the logo/buttons/avatars and a clipped 100deg gradient on the headline span; everything else is cool slate text on ink #0b0f14. Every glass surface = translucent dark fill + backdrop-blur(20-22px) saturate(140-160%) + a 1px rgba(255,255,255,.06-.07) hairline border. Status legibility: never rely on color alone, every status/priority carries a Phosphor icon AND a text label. Use Space Grotesk for the wordmark/headline/stat numerals and Inter for body. The table panel gets a soft layered teal+magenta drop shadow; primary CTAs get the glow-aqua shadow. Mobile reflow: nav center links and the Search chip hide, and below sm the data table is replaced by stacked card rows (preserving id/type/status/priority/owner) while sm-md keeps the table horizontally scrollable at min-w 640px.
